name: Hataraku Otona no Ren'ai Jijou
original_name: 働くオトナの恋愛事情
source:
The life of an ordinary salary-man. Early mornings, occasional overtime, eat, sleep, repeat. A normal life without any inconveniences or surprises. But one day, you feel compelled to take the casual words of your superior to heart: 

"Change is good, even if it's just a little."

Some change would be good-- just challenge yourself a little. Broaden your horizons, meet new people here and there. 

However, to your surprise. Immediately that night, you spontaneously find yourself in bed with a woman. A situation that the old you could have never even imagined happening.

And just like that, your mundane days of a salary-man would begin to change with each encounter...
translation:
普通工薪族的生活：清晨起床，偶尔加班，吃饭，睡觉，日复一日。生活平凡，没有不便，也没有惊喜。然而某天，你突然把上司随口说的话放在了心上：

“改变是好事，哪怕只有一点点。”

做出一些改变应该不错——稍微挑战自己，拓宽视野，认识不同的人。

可令你惊讶的是，就在那天晚上，你莫名其妙地和一名女人躺在同一张床上。这是过去的你绝不可能想象的情况。

就这样，工薪族平淡的日子随着一次次邂逅开始改变……
